title: Coffee Shop Pedals Cortado

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC 0 = Live knobs (preset off). PC 1–3 = onboard (red/green/blue). PC 4–20 = MIDI-only (light blue); empty slots do nothing. PC 126 = pedal Off. PC 127 = pedal On (no preset). Any PC 0–20 turns the pedal On. Save MIDI presets: hold PRESET 3s (LED white), then send PC 4–20. PC 21–125 unused.

additionalInfo: Coffee Shop Pedals Cortado MIDI page — Program Change only; no CC parameter map. TYPE_A same as Cold Brew / Portafilter / London Fog siblings.
